name: Fever Glitch!
source:
Welcome to Fever Glitch! 

This gay NSFW visual novel follows the story of James, a near-college-graduate, whose roommate Derek gets trapped in a virtual world at the hands of a mysterious and lustful villain...

Enter the Synapse and jump from game to game as you try to save your boyfriend! Er... best friend, not boyfriend. It's complicated.

You'll do whatever it takes to make sure he gets out of this unbelievable situation alive, even if it means using your body to do so...

[From [url=https://kritios.itch.io/fever-glitch]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到发烧故障！

这部NSFW同性恋视觉小说讲述了即将大学毕业的詹姆斯的故事，他的室友德里克被困在一个神秘而贪婪的恶棍手中的虚拟世界中……

进入突触并从一个游戏跳到另一个游戏，尝试拯救你的男朋友！呃…最好的朋友，不是男朋友。情况很复杂。

你会不惜一切代价确保他活着摆脱这种令人难以置信的处境，即使这意味着要用你的身体来做到这一点……

[来自[url=https://kritios.itch.io/fever-glitch]Itch.io[/url]]
